Relabel plot titles, legends and facet strips from a specification

Source: R/plot.R
ysx_plt_relab.Rd

Labels use yspec::axis_labs(), including units. Explicit labs entries override specification labels and can also label variables absent from the specification. Only direct variable mappings are relabelled; expressions and unmatched labels are left unchanged. Layer-specific mappings are supported.

Usage

ysx_plt_relab(
  x,
  spec = NULL,
  labs = list(),
  facet_labels = list(),
  var_map = character(),
  label_type = NULL
)

Arguments

x

A ggplot object or a list of ggplot objects.

spec

A loaded yspec object, or NULL to use only custom labels.

labs

A named list or character vector of variable labels.

facet_labels

A named list of named character vectors mapping facet levels to labels, for example list(SEX = c(F = "Female", M = "Male")).

var_map

A named character vector mapping plot variable names to specification variable names, for example c(wt = "WEIGHT"). This changes label lookup only, not plot data or mappings. Custom labels use plot names.

label_type

NULL (default) uses the usual axis labels. Otherwise, "long" or "short" selects that specification field, including units. An error is raised if the requested field is unavailable for a plotted specification variable, unless a custom label overrides it.

Value

A relabelled plot, or a list of relabelled plots.

Details

Facet strips show the variable label and level. Coded levels are decoded using the specification, with optional overrides in facet_labels. Existing facet labellers are replaced. Axis tick labels and legend entries are not changed. The input plot and specification are not modified.
